stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "You keep leaning on 'copies itself' and 'made its own'. Fine. Show me the copying. You have not shown me how a cell copies two metres of tape without a mistake, or what happens when it makes one. Until you do, 'copies itself' is a promise."
"A thermostat with a robot plumber that replaces it would be alive, then."

feedback.en: A robot plumber is made by a factory too. The regress ends at the cell, which makes its own parts from its own recipe, with no factory behind it.

text.en: "The flame responds to a draught, so it senses."

feedback.en: It bends because air pushes it, like a curtain. No receptor, no relay, no line held. That card was played in the Prologue.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed sensing ledger, a geyser thermostat strip on the table.
